section_summary.extract_value: Table 2 presents descriptive statistics (means and standard deviations) and results of Bonferroni-corrected t-tests examining sex differences across multiple variables including age, body mass index, erotophilia, sexual liberalism, technology liberalism, attitudes toward unconventional sex, body appreciation, authentic body pride, body acceptance from others, and body image flexibility. The sample consists of 151 women (M age = 34.26 years, M BMI = 25.88) and 163 men (M age = 30.97 years, M BMI = 25.82). The accompanying text describes regression analyses for technology liberalism, where sexual orientation and BMI were significant predictors in women, while body appreciation was the only significant predictor in men.
